title: Re-enactment of the Hartland Bridge Committe by anniversary committee
description: Premier Bernard Lord and his children, Sebastian and Jasmine, cut the ribbon to mark the start of the next 100 years for the Hartland Bridge. From left to right, those participating were Miss Hartland 2000 Crystal Mean, committee members Shirley Green and Rev. Maynard Rector, committee co-chair Doris E. Kennedy, Premier Lord, Hartland Town Clerk Judy Dee, Miss New Brunswick 2000 Heather Harris, and committee member and former mayor Betty Lou Craig.
